reasoning: Both meetings operate within the same established tightening regime: gradual rate hikes, accommodative stance, balance sheet normalization already underway, and identical forward guidance language about 'further gradual increases.' The March meeting delivered a routine 25bp hike (1-1/4 to 1-1/2 → 1-1/2 to 1-3/4) and a scheduled step-up in QT caps (Treasury from $12B to $18B, MBS from $8B to $12B), both of which were pre-announced elements of the existing normalization plan rather than a new regime. The policy statement language is nearly identical, with the only notable addition being 'The economic outlook has strengthened in recent months,' which is an incremental data acknowledgment within the existing stance.
key_quote: The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant further gradual increases in the federal funds rate; the federal funds rate is likely to remain, for some time, below levels that are expected to prevail in the longer run.
